steps: Visit the official portal and click on Register.
Choose Jan Aadhaar or Google to complete SSO registration and obtain your SSO id.
Log in to the portal and click on DE-HE.
Select Continue to RajSSP and click on Apply for Scheme.
Click on SCHOLARSHIP (SJE), fill out all relevant details, and submit.
parsed.department: Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan
